main_text.p: lorum[?] socius : alij authori Ecclesiastico, puta Clementi Romano, cujus jam olim celebris ad Corinthiorū Ecclesiam schismate laborantem Epistola; vel juxta quosdam ipsi Tertulliano, si vera refert Sixtus Senensis Biblioth. L. vii. C. viii: alij denique, qui erroris & νοθεύσεως[?] hanc postularunt Epistolam, homini hæretico & malo feriato, puta Novato, aut alij ejusdem furfuris.

VI. Nos, salvis magnorum hodieque virorum judiciis, illis accedimus, & cum iis facimus, qui Paulum authore pronunciarunt. Quod pluribus demonstrandum aggredimur, & quàm factum hactenus fusiùs & accuratiùs, cùm sententiam nostram varió tibicine fulciendo, tum argumenta, atque instantias omnium quotquot aliter hoc senserunt in argumento diluendo. Tribus partibus rem totam complexuri, quarum prima authoritates; altera rationes pro Paulo militantes; tertia objectiones vestiget & expendat. Authoritates aliae ferint[?] testimonij divini, aliae humani, sive publici, sive pri-vati,

page.notes: The first word of the page, "lorum", has a damaged initial letter; the likely reading is "eorum" and it is marked [?]. The Greek word after "&" is blurred and marked [?]; it appears to be νοθεύσεως. "ferint" is partly obscured by a dark mark and is marked [?]. The final line "vati," is set at the right margin as the continuation of "pri-" from the line above.
